verses.54:46: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

meaning: The root "dhy" primarily describes something that is near, close, or at hand. It can also refer to something that is ready or prepared. In a broader sense, it implies proximity and readiness.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
